ONDO (PSI 9.1): Gov Aiyedatiwa activated a 240kW solar system at UNIMEDTH Ondo (1.24M kWh/yr), approved FAST biodiversity budgeting, and received an Excellence Award at Public Service Week.
ADAMAWA (PSI 8.9): Gov Fintiri donated 15 Hilux vehicles and 300 motorcycles to traditional rulers across chiefdoms to strengthen grassroots intelligence against Boko Haram/ISWAP threats.
KADUNA (PSI 8.8): Gov Uba Sani signed the Rigasa Specialist Nursing College Bill, transferred Kafanchan Hospital to the FG for FMC upgrade, and inaugurated 12 state agency boards.
EBONYI (PSI 8.7): Gov Nwifuru received the IFAD-VCDP team, pledging counterpart fund scale-ups and requesting value chain project extension across all LGAs before December closure.
EDO (PSI 8.6): First Lady Sen. Oluremi Tinubu & Gov Okpebholo commissioned 50 CNG buses and launched a ₦1B grant for 5,000 operators; Business Ministry renewed WACOT fertilizer lease.
TARABA (PSI 8.5): Gov Agbu Kefas advanced state agricultural mechanization by deploying tractor fleets to every LGA to empower farmers, boost crop yields, and secure food systems.
RIVERS (PSI 8.4): Gov Fubara launched the Southern States Out-of-School Children Enrolment Drive alongside UBEC in Port Harcourt, calling for active community engagement.
FCT ABUJA (PSI 8.3): FCT Minister Wike delivered keynote during Idoma Hall of Fame induction, urging a shift from entitlement politics to institutional responsibility and infrastructure execution.
OGUN (PSI 8.2): Gov Abiodun intensified concrete drainage works on Ago-Iwoye Road and disbursed ₦1B in credit support to cooperatives and traders at International Cooperatives Day.
PLATEAU (PSI 8.1): Plateau inaugurated the 2026 Made-in-Plateau Committee to showcase manufacturing, while PRUWASSA partnered with Hydrologists to regulate unmonitored boreholes.
GOMBE (PSI 8.0): Gov Inuwa Yahaya flagged off 2-week training for 100 Tsangaya teachers with NALV and NEDC under GO-BEST program to integrate religious and modern education.
OYO (PSI 7.9): Oyo commissioned the Rule of Law Enforcement Authority (OYRLEA) office to enforce environmental/traffic laws, and advanced reconstruction of Ile-Ewe Road in Ogbomoso.
KATSINA (PSI 7.8): Gov Radda hosted Daura stakeholders announcing lodge revitalization, and addressed TETFund Town Hall in Abuja advocating sustained tertiary education funding.
BAYELSA (PSI 7.7): Former President Jonathan and Gov Diri advocated true fiscal federalism at Elder Ekiye's book launch in Yenagoa, calling for Niger Delta environmental justice.
ZAMFARA (PSI 7.6): UNICEF workshop urged Zamfara Imams to enrol daughters in school to stop female education apathy; Gov Lawal approved appointing 5 new Permanent Secretaries.
OSUN (PSI 7.5): Gov Adeleke approved mandatory weekly 2-hour environmental sanitation (8am-10am Thursdays) across offices and markets to prevent disease outbreaks.
LAGOS (PSI 7.4): LASEMA announced controlled demolition of structurally distressed Great Nigeria Insurance House on Lagos Island following technical assessments to avert collapse.
NASARAWA (PSI 7.3): Gov Abdullahi Sule made an executive inspection tour of ongoing construction at the University of Public Relations and Leadership in Gudi, Akwanga LGA.
ANAMBRA (PSI 7.2): Global MPI Briefing recorded Anambra as having the lowest severe multidimensional poverty rate in the South East zone at 9.6%, reflecting social delivery.
